You see a wand of cosmic energy.
Classification: 1 Tier: 0.
It can only be wielded properly by sorcerers of level 26 or higher.
It weighs 25.00 oz.
The energy of a radiant star is trapped inside its globe.

    Notes

    An upgrade from the Wand of Decay and the Wand of Draconia that makes them both largely obsolete, since, in addition to dealing more damage per shot, energy is considered to be a more useful element than fire and, at least at a lower level, death. It is the sorcerer's equivalent of the druid's Terra Rod. Reward in The Paradox Tower Quest.
    Needed for Mage Outfits Quest (male) and Summoner Outfits Quest (female).

    Weapon Proficiency

    1 2 3 4
    +5 mana on hit
    +5% critical extra damage for Energy spells and runes
    +3% critical extra damage for offensive runes
    +10% base damage for Energy Beam
    +10 mana on kill
    +1% critical extra hit chance for Energy spells and runes
    +1% critical hit chance for offensive runes

    History

    Wands of Cosmic Energy replaced the rare Yellow Spell Wands in Update 7.6.
